changeSet.author: openelisglobal
changeSet.comment: Register the qa.* permission keys as system modules
changeSet.sql: INSERT INTO clinlims.system_module (id, name, description, has_select_flag, has_add_flag, has_update_flag, has_delete_flag) SELECT nextval('clinlims.system_module_seq'), v.name, v.description, 'Y', 'N', 'N', 'N' FROM (VALUES ('qa.view.overview', 'Visibility of the Quality Assurance sidenav node and QA Overview page'), ('qa.view.qc', 'Visibility of the Statistical QC pillar (QC Dashboard, Alerts, config pages)'), ('qa.view.eqa', 'Visibility of the EQA pillar and EQA pages'), ('qa.view.qi', 'Visibility of the Quality Indicators pillar and QI Dashboard'), ('qa.view.qms', 'Visibility of the QMS pillar (NCE Register, Audit Trail)'), ('qa.manage.qi', 'Manage the Quality Indicator configuration (thresholds, enable/disable)'), ('qa.manage.accreditation', 'Manage accrediting bodies and per-test accreditation enrollment (Accreditation Status)') ) AS v(name, description) WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM clinlims.system_module m WHERE m.name = v.name);

changeSet.author: openelisglobal
changeSet.comment: Grant the qa.* permissions to QA Officer, Global Administrator and the compat roles
changeSet.sql: INSERT INTO clinlims.system_role_module (id, has_select, has_add, has_update, has_delete, system_role_id, system_module_id) SELECT nextval('clinlims.system_role_module_seq'), 'Y', 'N', 'N', 'N', r.id, m.id FROM (VALUES ('QA Officer', ARRAY['qa.view.overview','qa.view.qc','qa.view.eqa','qa.view.qi','qa.view.qms','qa.manage.qi','qa.manage.accreditation']), ('Global Administrator', ARRAY['qa.view.overview','qa.view.qc','qa.view.eqa','qa.view.qi','qa.view.qms','qa.manage.qi','qa.manage.accreditation']), ('Reception', ARRAY['qa.view.overview','qa.view.qi','qa.view.eqa','qa.view.qms']), ('Results', ARRAY['qa.view.overview','qa.view.qi','qa.view.eqa']), ('Validation', ARRAY['qa.view.overview','qa.view.qi','qa.view.qms']) ) AS g(role_name, module_names) JOIN clinlims.system_role r ON r.name = g.role_name JOIN clinlims.system_module m ON m.name::text = ANY(g.module_names) WHERE NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM clinlims.system_role_module x WHERE x.system_role_id = r.id AND x.system_module_id = m.id);

rollback.sql: DELETE FROM clinlims.system_role_module WHERE system_module_id IN (SELECT id FROM clinlims.system_module WHERE name LIKE 'qa.%');
